# SEO and GEO audit I read all 10 tracked files. The policy in `geo.config.json:6-9` is to allow AI search crawlers and block training crawlers. I checked the crawler rules against that policy. ## High priority 1. **`/pricing` is set to noindex but listed in the sitemap.** - `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` has `robots: { index: false, follow: true }`. The same page has a canonical URL and is listed in `public/sitemap.xml:4`. - Search engines and AI search will drop your most commercially important page, and the signals contradict each other. - Fix: remove the `robots` key. - `app/thank-you/page.tsx:1` is correctly noindexed and correctly left out of the sitemap. 2. **`/blog` content is invisible to crawlers.** - `app/blog/page.tsx:1` is a `'use client'` page that loads posts with `fetch('/api/posts')` in `useEffect` (lines 7-9). Crawlers that don't run JavaScript, which includes most AI crawlers, see only `

Blog

`. - There is no `/api/posts` route in the repo. - Posts render as bare titles (line 10), with no links and no per-post pages. - Because the page is a client component, it also can't export `metadata`, so it has no title or description. - Fix: - Make it a server component that fetches data on the server. - Export `metadata`. - Add `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` for each post, and link to it with `` or `Link`. - Add the posts to the sitemap. 3. **`robots.txt` doesn't enforce your training-crawler block.** - `public/robots.txt:4-5` blocks only GPTBot. - Other training crawlers are still allowed through `User-agent: *`: `CCBot`, `Google-Extended`, `anthropic-ai`, `ClaudeBot`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Bytespider` and `Meta-ExternalAgent`. - Fix: add a `Disallow: /` group for each of them. - Search and retrieval bots (`OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `Claude-User`) are allowed today through `*`. I suggest explicit `Allow: /` groups so a later edit can't block them by accident. - There is no `Sitemap:` line. Add `Sitemap: https://www.ledger.example/sitemap.xml`. 4. **There is no structured data anywhere.** - No JSON-LD in `app/layout.tsx` or any page. - Fix: add `Organization` and `WebSite` JSON-LD in the layout. Add `SoftwareApplication` with `Offer` on `app/pricing/page.tsx`. Add `Article` on blog posts. - This is the biggest lever for AI citation and rich results. ## Medium priority 5. **`` has no `lang` attribute** (`app/layout.tsx:11`). `geo.config.json:4` says `en`. Use ``. 6. **Titles and descriptions are thin or duplicated.** - `app/docs/page.tsx:1` has the title "Docs" and `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` has "Pricing". Neither names the product or says what the page offers. - `app/thank-you/page.tsx:1` has the title "Thanks". - `app/page.tsx:1` repeats the layout metadata word for word. - Fix: use `title: { template: '%s | Ledger', default: ... }` in the layout. Write specific titles and descriptions per page. 7. **There are no social or sharing tags.** `app/layout.tsx:3-7` has no `openGraph`, `twitter`, or image. Add them, plus a favicon. 8. **Canonicals are inconsistent.** `app/page.tsx` and `app/pricing/page.tsx` set one, but `app/docs/page.tsx` and `app/blog/page.tsx` don't. Set `alternates.canonical` in the layout (or per page) for every indexable page. 9. **The content is too thin for AI search.** - Each page has one `

` and one sentence (`app/page.tsx:4`, `app/docs/page.tsx:3`, `app/pricing/page.tsx:3`). - There are no `

` sections, FAQs, feature lists, plan details or concrete numbers. - Add answer-style content that a model can quote, such as "What is Ledger?", plan tiers with prices, and a docs structure. ## Low priority 10. **The sitemap has no ``** (`public/sitemap.xml:3-6`). It is also hand-maintained and will drift as blog posts are added. Consider `app/sitemap.ts` to generate it. 11. **The nav uses plain `` tags** (`app/layout.tsx:13`). `next/link` gives client-side navigation and prefetching. Crawling works either way. 12. **There is no `llms.txt`.** Optionally add `public/llms.txt` with a short site summary and key links. Support for it is still inconsistent. ## Checked and fine - `data-nosnippet` on the cookie banner (`app/layout.tsx:15`) is appropriate. - `metadataBase` is set. - The thank-you page is correctly noindexed and kept out of the sitemap. I haven't changed anything. I can apply the fixes, starting with items 1, 3, 5 and 2.
